symptom: Before the fix, synthetic rehashed shadow evidence could keep unresolvedCount nonzero while deleting its reason counts, change count values to non-integers, or relabel the taxonomy map without a validation error. Hidden, symbol, inherited and accessor properties on dynamic count maps also escaped the runtime shape check. No real research evidence corruption or production impact was observed.
lesson: Validating fixed shadow-evidence fields and its content digest is not enough: caller-controlled dynamic count dictionaries can suppress or relabel failure evidence even after recomputing the digest. JSON Schema countMap constraints and own-property shape checks must be enforced by the runtime validator too.
guardrail: Require plain own enumerable data entries and safe nonnegative integer values for every reason and taxonomy count map; reject hidden/symbol/accessor/inherited and forbidden reason keys. Require reason-count coverage for unresolved/rejected rows and recompute taxonomy from reason keys plus conflict count. Regression-test rehashed synthetic mutations, preserving valid multi-reason rows. This never authenticates independent sources or authorizes scoring/production.
